en.headline: 20,000 civil servants to join Huanggang Port peak-capacity drill on Saturday
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the second large-scale cross-boundary exercise with Shenzhen will test the new control point under maximum pressure before opening.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Wednesday that about 20,000 civil servants will take part in a second major joint drill at the new Huanggang Port this Saturday to test the facility’s capacity at peak times.

Lee said the previous Saturday’s exercise involving 10,000 civil servants had proved effective in examining passenger and vehicle flows. Over the past three weeks more than 80 tests and drills of different forms had been conducted, with lessons applied after each one.
He reiterated that the port would open to the public as soon as conditions are fully ready and operations are confirmed to be safe, orderly and providing a good passenger experience.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸周六兩萬公務員演練測試頂峰承受力
zh.dek: 行政長官李家超表示，港深第二次大型跨境演練將測試口岸高峰承載能力，條件充分時會盡快開通。
body: 行政長官李家超周三表示，本周六將有約兩萬名公務員參與新皇崗口岸第二次大型聯合演練，測試口岸在高峰時段的承受能力。
李家超指上周六約一萬名公務員的演練非常有效，有助檢視人流及車流管理。過去三周已進行逾80次不同形式的測試及演練，每次均總結經驗以改善運作。
他重申，當條件充分、整體運作暢順安全有序，旅客體驗良好時，當局會盡快開放口岸予公眾使用，並適時公布開通日期。
